description: Agent Delegation: submit a delegator’s selection flow: the delegate chosen, the task and when it was handed over, how the delegate’s identity was checked (verified, taken on its own word, or not checked) and against what (a registry record, a signed credential, an attester, a prior working relationship or other), whether a track record was looked at, where it came from (a public record, an attester, the delegator’s own history or the delegate’s own claims), whether it covers comparable work and was public before the delegate’s first engagement, and whether fit for this task was checked, with what the task needs and what the delegate showed, each with when it was checked. The signed report says whether the delegate was checked before the handoff on identity, track record on comparable work and fit for this task specifically, and names an unchecked or self-declared identity, no track record looked at and every check done after the handoff, then a self-reported or non-comparable record, a record assembled after first use, fit not checked and every need not shown met, with the fix for each. This reads the delegator’s diligence before the handoff: whether a purchase receipt’s buyer identity matches its delegation is wever_delegated-identity-check, one identity record’s own consistency is wever_agent-identity-check and whether a handoff route checks its receiver against the registry is wever_receiver-identity-check. Verdict stranger_handoff, vetting_gaps, vetting_unverified or delegate_vetted. POST /api/delegate-vetting-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-delegation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-delegation/.

delegate.description: The delegate chosen, such as the invoice reconciliation agent.

delegator.description: Who hands the work over, such as the procurement agent.

checked.description: Fit for this task was checked before the handoff.

needs.description: What this task needs, such as read access to the invoice ledger or same-day turnaround.

shown.description: The needs the delegate showed it meets, by name.

handoff_at.description: When the work was handed over.

checked.description: How the delegate’s identity was checked: verified against something the delegate does not control, taken on the delegate’s own word, or not checked.

method.description: What it was checked against: a registry record, a signed credential, an attester, a prior working relationship, or something else.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

task.description: The work handed over, such as reconciling the October invoices.

checked.description: A track record was looked at before the handoff.

checked_at.description: When the track record was checked.

comparable.description: The record covers work comparable to this task.

public_before_first_use.description: The record was public before the delegate’s first engagement, not assembled afterward.

source.description: Where the record came from: a public record, an attester, the delegator’s own history with the delegate, or the delegate’s own claims.

name: wever_delegate-vetting-check
title: Delegate vetting check
